agent-reliability.description: Applies site reliability engineering practice to agents and AI products: SLOs, trace-based SLIs, autonomy levels, tool blast radius, eval-gated releases, drift, incidents, postmortems, capacity, toil and launch review.

apply-playbooks.description: Finds the playbooks that apply to a change, turns their key rules into acceptance criteria, and records in the pull request which rules the change followed.

context-efficient-session.description: Keeps an agent session's context small and traceable with a bounded startup inventory, quiet command output, and checkpoints before compacting or resuming.

correct.description: Turns a mistake that agents keep repeating into a structural guard, such as a type, lint rule, CI check or test, proven against a real past instance.

diagnosing-bugs.description: Diagnoses a bug, failure or regression before fixing it by reproducing it and testing one hypothesis at a time.

service-observability.description: Adds or reviews logging, trace propagation, metrics and SLOs for backend services.

spec-delivery-loop.description: Turns an approved specification into a verified change through a plan, the smallest coherent change, focused tests, a gate, independent review and bounded repair.

system-design-assessment.description: Reviews a design before it is built for boundaries, data ownership, security, reliability, deployment, scale, and synchronous versus asynchronous calls.
